messages:
elaine_marketing: Quick sync — launching a small pricing experiment next week. plan: 2 calculator entry points (simple estimator vs advanced configurator), 3 tier name variants, and a tiny FAQ refresh. needs: final microcopy, tracking checklist, and webinar CTA tie-in. who can own each?

tom_growth: I can own tracking + inbound routing. want to route advanced leads to SDR queue and simple estimates to self-serve funnel. will post routing map by EOD. :white_check_mark:

maya_design: I'll finish the microcopy for the calculator UI and three tier name lockups. leaning toward: "Core / Scale / Dedicated" but open to suggestions — want short labels for mobile.

ryan_product: Can we surface the webinar as a contextual CTA inside the advanced configurator only? intent is to catch teams likely to commit. also suggest we add a small benchmark blurb: "avg latency / cost per 1k tokens" — helps enterprise trust.

beth_custsuc: FAQ updates — I'll trim the long answer about quotas and add a line about Dedicated contracts + a link to docs. also propose an FAQ card: "Which calculator should I use?" with 2 bullets.

nora_metrics: For analytics, we need these events: `estimator_start`, `configurator_start`, `tier_select`, `faq_click`, `webinar_cta_click`. Also include `lead_route` with payload {source, tier_choice, estimate_value}. Tom, do you want the schema?

tom_growth: yes pls post schema here. I'll wire the inbound rules once we agree on keys.

elaine_marketing: Nora — can you add conversion thresholds for switching users to the webinar CTA? e.g., configurator with >3 options toggled or estimate > $2k/mo.

nora_metrics: yep — will add thresholds and a dashboard. will share a looker link tomorrow.

maya_design: Tier name alternatives: "Core / Scale / Shield" or "Starter / Business / Enterprise" — first is concise and product-y; second is customer-facing. which tone we want?

ryan_product: I prefer product-y for site copy, customer-facing in sales handoff. marketing should A/B the two to see which increases upgrade click-through.

beth_custsuc: Also recommend we add a short trust line under the calculator footer: "Used in production by teams at X, Y — SLA options available." keeps support inbox calm.

elaine_marketing: Good. Action items: Maya — microcopy + three name variants by tomorrow 11a. Tom — routing map + schema by EOD. Nora — events + thresholds by tomorrow noon. Beth — FAQ card drafts by tomorrow 3p. Ryan — confirm webinar CTA placement and benchmark blurb. I'll collate and post the final payload to the staging PR.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: staging/pricing-experiments -> 2026-03-24T02:00Z. Review checklist: copy, analytics, samples.

tom_growth: noted. planning to route `lead_route` to /sdr if tier_select == "Dedicated" or estimate_value > 2000. will add an override for enterprise flagged via SSO.

maya_design: posting the microcopy mock in Figma now: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/pricing-estimator — feedback welcome. :eyes:

nora_metrics: linking draft event schema: https://notion.redwood/analytics/pricing-estimator-schema. tag me on comments if anything missing.

elaine_marketing: Awesome — last ask: keep responses short in this thread so I can paste into the PR. thanks everyone! :sparkles:
